parameters.query:
=SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    p.category,
    p.color,
    p.movement,
    p.material,
    p.water_resistance_m,
    p.warranty_months,
    p.active_discount_percent,
    p.price_inr,
    p.price_aed,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.stock_quantity), 0) AS stock
FROM workspace.agentic_support.products p
LEFT JOIN workspace.agentic_support.inventory i
    ON i.sku = p.sku
WHERE
    LOWER(p.sku) = LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}')
    OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER('{{ $json.product_a }}'), '%')
GROUP BY
    p.sku,
    p.name,
    p.category,
    p.color,
    p.movement,
    p.material,
    p.water_resistance_m,
    p.warranty_months,
    p.active_discount_percent,
    p.price_inr,
    p.price_aed
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 5;
